_meta.purpose: Offline/Admin fixture for Slice H readiness — non-contiguous Mon+Thu service_dates on an existing course. Not a scheduling redesign; Captain selects exact service_dates on a course that already runs those days (or has open capacity). Contiguous date_from/date_to fallback remains for non-course callers.
captain_setup: 1. Pick (or create) a Group course whose schedule includes Monday and Thursday sessions (e.g. weekly mon_thu, or open custom dates).
2. Do NOT invent custom weekday Admin UI if Admin only supports fixed weekly packs — use the course's existing eligible days.

3. Staff Create: select the course, set From=Mon / To=Thu only if the product expands contiguous days; preferred: pass exact service_dates [Mon, Thu] from the course day buttons when multi-day selection supports it.
4. Create body must carry service_dates: ["YYYY-MM-DD mon", "YYYY-MM-DD thu"] — not a contiguous range that includes Tue/Wed for stock claims.
5. Stock sold-out on Mon or Thu fails closed (zero writes). Sold-out on a gap day (Tue/Wed) is irrelevant when service_dates are exact Mon+Thu.

stock_claims_contract.contiguous_fallback: when service_dates omitted, collectCourseEquipmentStockClaims uses inclusive date_from..date_to (unchanged for non-course callers)
